subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 8 and 4200, respectively. If one of the numbers is 168, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of numbers = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

**Other Number** = (8 × 4200) ÷ 168

**Other Number** = 4200 ÷ 21 = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 8

**L.C.M.** = 4200

**First Number (n₁)** = 168

**Formula Used:**

n₁ × n₂ = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e8363cb7ca502c44658a5df697fb11ce254c5592e1998940a36d76fd1eff1f9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 168 × n₂ = 8 × 4200

⇒ n₂ = (8 × 4200) ÷ 168

⇒ n₂ = 33600 ÷ 168

⇒ n₂ = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Property of HCF and LCM

For any two positive integers a and b, **HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b**. This property holds true only for two numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are **co-prime**, their **HCF** is always 1 and their **LCM** is equal to their product.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

**HCF** = HCF of Numerators ÷ LCM of Denominators; **LCM** = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators.</p
